_note: Real-world intervention names associated with each mutable feature's clinically-admissible direction, cited against the SAME guideline registry already used in src/graph/neurosymbolic.py ([PCE2013], [HTN2017], [ADA2023], [CHOL2018]). These are named intervention CATEGORIES from established clinical guidance, not fabricated numbers -- no dose, percentage, or outcome statistic is claimed here; those come only from this project's own executed code (feature deltas, risk scores).

resting_bp.name: DASH diet + sodium restriction
resting_bp.description: Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) eating pattern and reduced dietary sodium, the guideline's first-line lifestyle intervention for lowering blood pressure.

systolic_bp.name: DASH diet + sodium restriction
systolic_bp.description: Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) eating pattern and reduced dietary sodium, the guideline's first-line lifestyle intervention for lowering blood pressure.

diastolic_bp.name: DASH diet + sodium restriction
diastolic_bp.description: Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) eating pattern and reduced dietary sodium, the guideline's first-line lifestyle intervention for lowering blood pressure.

cholesterol.name: Statin therapy + reduced dietary saturated fat
cholesterol.description: Lipid-lowering pharmacotherapy (statins) combined with reduced saturated/trans fat intake, the guideline's core approach to lowering LDL/total cholesterol.

bmi.name: Structured weight-management program
bmi.description: A combined dietary-calorie-reduction and physical-activity program aimed at gradual, sustained weight loss.

glycemic_hba1c.name: Glycemic control program (diet, exercise, medication adherence)
glycemic_hba1c.description: Combined lifestyle and pharmacologic management of blood glucose aimed at lowering HbA1c toward guideline targets.

fasting_blood_sugar.name: Glycemic control program (diet, exercise, medication adherence)
fasting_blood_sugar.description: Combined lifestyle and pharmacologic management of blood glucose.

max_heart_rate.name: Supervised cardiovascular exercise training
max_heart_rate.description: A structured aerobic exercise program aimed at improving exercise capacity (reflected in a higher achievable heart rate during exercise testing).

oldpeak.name: Cardiac rehabilitation / anti-ischemic therapy
oldpeak.description: Guideline-directed medical therapy and supervised cardiac rehabilitation aimed at reducing exercise-induced ST-segment depression, a marker of myocardial ischemia.

exercise_angina.name: Anti-anginal therapy + cardiac rehabilitation
exercise_angina.description: Medical therapy and supervised exercise rehabilitation aimed at reducing or eliminating exercise-induced chest pain.

slope.name: Guideline-directed medical therapy for ischemia
slope.description: Medical management aimed at improving the ST-segment response pattern observed during exercise testing.
